wrDoubleCount.detail: independent hybrid used meanNaturalX (WR-off MC) × absolute start-tier probs + separate analytical WR fill contribution. It did NOT use meanX (w/ WR).

phase56DoubleCount.detail: 7C independent hybrid = eNone + sum(p_tier * buy_meanNaturalX) + WR. buy_meanNaturalX is a FINAL live-resolver bonus EV (PT2H+BODY1+Phase6). It does not additionally add Phase5B 17.927 or Phase6 4.689 deltas. Historical 96.29 projection DOES use staged 5B+6 buckets then deltas — that is a different estimator, not mixed into the hybrid total.

rootCause: 1) Phase 7C independent hybrid omitted trigger-spin BASE win (~+0.28pp when restored). 2) BASE LUT freegame_* books are finite buy-book slices whose meanX exceeds 200k buy_ev (LARGE_HILL alone ~0.67 pp) — explains ~0.75pp LUT vs old hybrid. 3) Perfect V LUT weight floor (max weight 1) overweights p by ~7.6x (RTP ~0.002pp). 4) After correction, authoritative ~97.6–98.1% still >96.70 — economy likely hot, but acceptance gate fails until BASE freegame means are reconciled to long-run EV.
